SECTION 2: KEYSTONE AI PROTOCOLS — ARCHITECTURAL OVERVIEW (PUBLIC SPECIFICATION)
================================================================================
Keystone AI Protocols (https://keystonerecomposition.com/ai-protocols/) documents a local-first, bring-your-own-key (BYOK) autonomous engineering methodology designed to replace fragmented cloud SaaS wrappers with deterministic multi-agent orchestration.

### 2.1 The 30-Agent Subagent-First Architecture
Rather than overloading a single monolithic context window where reasoning degrades across unrelated file edits, media synthesis, and live verification, Keystone AI Protocols partitions complex engineering workflows across a 30-Agent Subagent-First topology:
- **Tier A — High-Velocity Discovery Scouts**: Lightweight parallel scouts perform repository symbol mapping, multi-source RFC and documentation verification, and local workstation telemetry checks before architectural planning begins, keeping the primary orchestrator context clean and free of raw log noise.
- **Tier B — Domain-Isolated Specialist Squads**: Dedicated specialist roles own strictly partitioned domains—test-driven software architecture, full-stack web and Schema.org GEO deployment, broadcast media timeline assembly, audio catalog reconciliation, quantitative expected-value modeling, and B2B construction feasibility intelligence.
- **Adversarial Verification Gates**: Every build phase separates implementation from verification. Independent review gates enforce red-to-green automated test suites, static syntax validation, live HTTP endpoint inspection, and DOM-level rendering verification before any artifact is accepted.

### 2.2 FastMCP Typed Tool Contracts
Inter-agent and workstation-to-application boundaries are governed by typed Model Context Protocol (FastMCP) server contracts rather than brittle shell string concatenation:
- **Schema-Validated Payloads**: Every tool surface exposes strict input and output data contracts with deterministic error envelopes, idempotency guards, and explicit domain jails.
- **Zero-Cloud Authenticated Browser Attachment**: Instead of spawning fragile headless browser containers that lose session state and trigger anti-automation loops, workstation workflows attach cleanly to dedicated temporary tabs inside an authenticated desktop Chrome session over the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP), preserving human-in-the-loop visibility and strict tab isolation.
- **Hybrid Local Knowledge Retrieval**: Markdown engineering ledgers, canonical wikilinks, and structured JSON registries are indexed locally so multi-agent squads resolve exact architectural facts without hallucinating external assumptions.

### 2.3 Tauri v2 Native Desktop Workspace
The operator interface is built on a native Rust and Tauri v2 desktop workspace architecture:
- **Low-Overhead Native Footprint**: Replaces memory-heavy Electron wrappers with a native OS webview and Rust systems core, leaving workstation GPU VRAM and system RAM dedicated to creative rendering, local inference, and 4K video mastering.
- **Unified Command HUD**: Provides real-time visibility into active multi-agent squads, live verification receipts, asset pipelines, and sovereign audio playback in a Quiet Luxury obsidian-and-gold visual hierarchy.

### 2.4 Local 2-Daemon Voice STT/TTS Bridge
Hands-free architectural dictation and spoken executive telemetry operate through a streamlined 2-Daemon Voice Bridge:
- **Dedicated Speech-to-Text (STT) Service**: Captures low-latency spoken engineering directives locally on workstation hardware with instant Push-to-Talk responsiveness.
- **Dedicated Text-to-Speech (TTS) Service**: Delivers concise, natural spoken status briefings and verification confirmations while maintaining minimal background daemon overhead.

### 2.5 The 3-Force Hologram Media Production Pipeline
High-cadence 4K educational briefings and somatic music cinema are produced through a synchronized 3-Force pipeline:
- **Force 1 — Generative Visual Direction**: Scene-consistent 16:9 4K visual sequences and holographic builder boardroom environments engineered with strict wardrobe, lighting, and framing continuity.
- **Force 2 — Somatic & Bio-Acoustic Mastering**: Original 24-bit studio compositions (melodic deep house, organic cello and violin ensembles, and 432Hz/528Hz harmonic structures) produced and registered with canonical TooLost ISRCs.
- **Force 3 — Automated Non-Linear Timeline Assembly**: Programmatic 2-track master timeline assembly in DaVinci Resolve Studio with precision voiceover loudness normalization, dynamic background music ducking, and direct 4K broadcast mastering.
